topic: Configuring and Calculating Late Fee Fines
summary: This topic explains how to set up and automatically calculate late fee fines based on predefined due dates and specific criteria, such as a fixed amount after a grace period or a daily increasing charge.
steps: (Admin) Define the fine criteria in the system's configuration settings.
(Admin) Set the last date for fee payment for each installment (e.g., 10th of the month/quarter).
(Admin) Specify the base fine amount (e.g., Rs. 500).
(Admin) Define the frequency and increment of the fine (e.g., Rs. 500 added after every 15 days, or Rs. 40 added per day after the due date).
During fee collection, if the payment date is past the configured due date, the system will automatically calculate and display the applicable fine.
business_rules: Fines are calculated automatically based on the configured criteria and the actual payment date.
Fine criteria can be set to apply uniformly to every course and every student, or specific rules can be defined.
Different fine calculation methods (fixed amount after period, daily increment) are supported.
important_notes: The specific fine criteria (amount, frequency, and application) must be confirmed and communicated to the ERP team for accurate setup.
The system will show the calculated fine at the time of fee collection if the payment is late.
